_note: Worked example of content.json. Paths are illustrative; copy the structure, not the values.

blocks.text: The bridge connects an APB4 completer port to a TL-UL manager port inside one clock domain. It accepts one APB transfer at a time and turns it into a single TileLink Uncached Lightweight (TL-UL) request, then returns the TL-UL response as the APB completion.

items: Constant TL-UL source identifier configured by PARA_SRC_ID (REQ-IF-005).

blocks.text: The IP sits between the peripheral bus fabric and the TL-UL crossbar. It owns the APB handshake, the legality check, the A-channel launch and the response mapping, and it holds no software-visible state.
Scope: the bridge does not buffer more than one request, does not reorder, and does not perform partial-word writes.

items: A write with any PSTRB value other than 4'b1111 completes with PSLVERR and issues no TL-UL request.
A transfer with PADDR[1:0] not equal to 2'b00 completes with PSLVERR and issues no TL-UL request.

control_and_status_registers.reason: The IP exposes no software-visible register; configuration is elaboration-time only (DEC-CSR-001).

overview_purpose_use_case_and_scope.text: A legal APB request is latched in the Setup phase and launched on channel A in the cycle after Setup ends. The function covers the request fields, the legality check, and the launch handshake.

function_description.text: When PSEL is high and PENABLE is low, the bridge samples PADDR, PWRITE, PSTRB and PWDATA and evaluates legality. A legal request asserts a_valid in the next cycle with a_opcode, a_address, a_mask and a_data derived from the latched APB fields. Channel A is held stable until a_ready is observed.

a_opcode = PWRITE ? PutFullData : Get
a_mask   = 4'b1111
a_size   = 2'b10 (4 bytes)

if_001_apb4_completer_port.text: The APB4 port carries the register access from the peripheral bus. All signals are synchronous to i_clk_core and are active-high unless the name ends in _n.

rows: Width of PADDR and of the TL-UL address
Width of the TL-UL source identifier
Constant source identifier of every request
